login_note: NASA Earthdata login is not set up on this server. Disaster Mapping shows NASA's public optical images (Landsat and Sentinel-2), which cannot see through clouds and arrive about a day later. Radar images that see through clouds need the login.

source.name: Synthetic fixture (shaped like: NASA JPL OPERA DSWx-HLS (water seen by satellite))
source.credit: Synthetic data for testing; not from: Water seen by satellite: NASA JPL OPERA DSWx-HLS (PO.DAAC, doi:10.5067/OPDSW-PL3V1); contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data

caveats: Water seen by satellite (NASA OPERA), Oct 31, 2026, 10:00 AM MDT. It includes the river's normal water. Clouds (25% of this area), trees, buildings and the days between passes hide water: dry pixels do not mean no flooding.
